issues.detail: Spec does not distinguish same-edge vs next-edge assertion after final 1101 bit; contract selects same_cycle and rule uncertain=true.
issues.spec_evidence: When the sequence is found, it should set start_shifting to 1, forever, until reset.
issues.alternative: Assert start_shifting on the next sampled posedge after the completing data bit.

issues.detail: S03 gives active-high synchronous reset but not start_shifting value while reset is asserted; contract assumes 0 and rule uncertain=false despite listed ambiguity.
issues.alternative: start_shifting retains its previous value while reset is asserted.

issues.detail: Spec does not define start_shifting before detection; contract assumes 0 and rule uncertain=false despite listed ambiguity.
issues.spec_evidence: When the sequence is found, it should set start_shifting to 1, forever, until reset.
issues.alternative: start_shifting may be 1 before any detection if its initial value is not defined to 0.
